title: MARKER BEACON - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What precautions and steps are required to properly remove and reinstall the marker beacon antenna on the aircraft's fuselage?
answer: Remove the Marker Beacon Antenna . (1) Make sure the MASTER and AVIONICS switches are in the off position. (2) Remove the baggage compartment lower access panel. Refer to Chapter 25, Interior Upholstery - Maintenance Practices. (3)  Remove the aft floorboard access/inspection plate to get access to the marker beacon antenna. (4)  Disconnect the coaxial cable  from the antenna. (5) Remove the screws that attach the antenna to the bottom of the fuselage.Install the Marker Beacon Antenna . (1) Put the marker beacon antenna in position on the bottom of the fuselage. (2) Attach the antenna with screws. Attach the coaxial cable  to the antenna. Install the access/inspection plate to the floor of the airplane. (5) Install the baggage compartment lower access panel. Refer to Chapter 25, Interior Upholstery

Refer to Chapter 25, Interior Upholstery - Maintenance Practices. (3)  Remove the aft floorboard access/inspection plate to get access to the marker beacon antenna. (4)  Disconnect the coaxial cable  from the antenna. (5) Remove the screws that attach the antenna to the bottom of the fuselage.Install the Marker Beacon Antenna . (1) Put the marker beacon antenna in position on the bottom of the fuselage. (2) Attach the antenna with screws. Attach the coaxial cable  to the antenna. Install the access/inspection plate to the floor of the airplane. (5) Install the baggage compartment lower access panel. Refer to Chapter 25, Interior Upholstery
